errors.evidence: The description transliterates the category labels from Cyrillic to Latin script, which is incorrect. The original labels are "статистики", "отчети", etc. Additionally, the order in which the labels are listed in the description is random and does not correspond to the order of the bars (from left to right) or the list of labels in the figure (from bottom to top).

errors.text_span: и те имат височини съответно 7, 2, 3, 1, 5 и 1
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the sequence of bar heights. The actual values for the bars from left to right are 7, 2, 1, 3, 5, and 1. The description has swapped the values for the third and fourth bars (reporting 3 and 1, instead of 1 and 3).

errors.text_span: а най-ниските стълбове са за "RSS" и "signali za zabelyazani netochnosti" със стойност 1
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the categories corresponding to the lowest value of 1. The bars with a value of 1 correspond to the categories "alerts услуги" (third bar) and "друго" (sixth bar). The description incorrectly claims they are for "RSS" (which has a value of 3) and "signali za zabelyazani netochnosti" (which has a value of 5).

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа етикети за различните категории
errors.evidence: The category labels are not located on the horizontal axis itself but are listed separately to the right of the plot. Describing them as being on the axis is imprecise.
